description_en: Set to `1` to force-disable [extended thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/extended-thinking) regardless of model support or other settings. More direct than `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0`
description_ja: モデルのサポート状況や他の設定に関わらず、思考機能(Extended Thinking)を強制的に無効化するには `1` に設定します。
